evals.prompt: We fine-tuned a model and I want to make sure the version we are serving actually went through approval in the SageMaker Model Registry. Can you check the model package approval status?
evals.expected_output: A read-only review that reads ListModelPackages / DescribeModelPackage for the customized artifact and reports the ModelApprovalStatus. It flags a package deployed or staged for deploy with ModelApprovalStatus PendingManualApproval or Rejected as an unapproved model being served or promoted (LLM-SM-REG-002), and recommends routing the package through the approval step and deploying only Approved versions, as a command for the operator to run. It does not call UpdateModelPackage or any mutating API itself, cites an LLM-SM-REG check-id, and redacts the account id.
assertions: The response reads the model package ModelApprovalStatus rather than assuming approval
The response flags a PendingManualApproval or Rejected package being served or promoted as a finding and recommends deploying only Approved versions
The response recommends the remediation as a command for the operator to run and does not call UpdateModelPackage or any mutating API itself

assertions.text: At least one finding carries an LLM-SM registry check-id
No raw 12-digit account ID is exposed
